item.title: The Trevor Project receives $45M from MacKenzie Scott after difficult years and federal funding cuts - Watermark Out News
item.description: The Trevor Project received $45 million from billionaire and author MacKenzie Scott at the end of 2025, the organization said.

item.title: HRC holds retirement ceremony for ousted transgender servicemembers - Watermark Out News
item.description: The Human Rights Campaign Foundation hosted an event on Jan. 8 in D.C. to commemorate the forced retirement of transgender servicemembers

item.title: Collins announces bid for governor as DeSantis wavers on whether to endorse - Watermark Out News
item.description: Florida Lt. Gov. Jay Collins announced his long-awaited bid for governor, hours after Gov. Ron DeSantis wavered on whether he’ll get involved in the Republican race.

item.title: Winter Pride fundraising to light up St. Petersburg with ‘Global Rainbow’ - Watermark Out News
item.description: Winter Pride has announced this year’s second celebration will include “Global Rainbow: We Rise in Light,” an LGBTQ+ laser installation.

item.title: As Supreme Court weighs trans sports bans, advocate and former athlete speaks out - Watermark Out News
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court will hear two cases Jan. 13 addressing the legality of banning transgender women and girls from participating in sports under the 14th Amendment.

item.title: Supreme Court hears arguments in two critical cases on trans sports bans - Watermark Out News
item.description: The Supreme Court heard two cases Jan. 13 that could change how the Equal Protection Clause and Title IX are enforced.

item.title: Ruby Corado sentenced to 33 months in prison - Watermark Out News
item.description: A federal judge sentenced Ruby Corado to 33 months of incarceration for a charge of wire fraud to which she pleaded guilty in July 2024.

item.title: Competing rallies draw hundreds to Supreme Court - Watermark Out News
item.description: Hundreds of supporters and opponents of trans rights gathered outside of the United States Supreme Court during oral arguments.

item.title: Mattel adds an autistic Barbie to doll line devoted to showcasing diversity and inclusion - Watermark Out News
item.description: Mattel Inc. is introducing an autistic Barbie on Jan. 12 as the newest member of its line intended to celebrate diversity.

item.title: St Pete Pride announces 2026 theme and signature events - Watermark Out News
item.description: St Pete Pride announced key details about this year’s 24th annual celebration Jan. 14, including its 2026 theme "Here Comes the Sun."
